## AETHELGARD // Ether-Core Extraction

A playable first-person extraction slice set in the badlands of Aethelgard. Cross the dunes,
crack supply caches, mine glowing Ether-Core, put down rogue drones, and hold Lift 04 long
enough to bank your haul. Die — or abandon the run — and the wasteland keeps the cargo.

This is a self-contained Three.js prototype with no build step and no runtime network calls.

### Run it

```bash
# from this directory, using any static file server
python3 -m http.server 3002
# then open http://localhost:3002
```

In the OMGithub playground, `./start.sh` serves the same static site.

### Controls

| Input | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `W` `A` `S` `D` | Move |
| `Shift` | Sprint (drains stamina) |
| `Space` | Jump |
| `Left mouse` | Fire (full-auto / pump) |
| `Right mouse` | Aim down sights |
| `1` `2` `3` | Equip VK-7 rifle, VX-4 SMG, or C-9 shotgun |
| `Q` | Cycle weapons |
| `R` | Reload |
| `E` | Interact / mine / call lift |
| `Esc` | Pause |
| `Touch` | On-screen stick, fire, reload and use buttons |

### Loadout

- **VK-7 "Scrapper"** — 30-round assault rifle, balanced damage and recoil.
- **VX-4 "Hornet"** — 36-round SMG, fast fire rate, wider spread.
- **C-9 "Cinder"** — 6-shell pump shotgun, eight-pellet spread and heavy recoil.

Each weapon tracks its own magazine and reserve ammo, and aims down its own sights/optic.

### Economy note

The economy is **simulated for the prototype**. Extracted Scrap and $AETHER are written to a
local wallet in `localStorage` under `aethelgard.wallet.v1`; there is no wallet connection,
token, or blockchain transaction. One Ether-Core pays out 25 $AETHER on a successful ascent.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add a story-driven campaign mode with a compelling narrative to the existing Aethelgard extraction shooter, on top of the completed controller support.

## Requirements
- User request: “Lets give it a campaign mode with a wicked story”
- Build autonomously without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly.
- Preserve existing free-hunt/extraction gameplay, keyboard/mouse, touch, and controller support.
- Save verification screenshots as JPEGs at ≤1280px wide; model cannot view images, so verify via DOM/JS state.

## Decisions
- Campaign title: **THE MOURNING CHOIR**, five operations with radio dialogue, briefings, objectives, a boss, and two endings.
- Story premise: Ether-Core contains colonist minds; MOTH extracts them; the Warden is Ivo Kestrel; the player is the last copy of Dr. Mara Voss, who caused the Corefall.
- Campaign missions: `DEAD LETTER`, `THE CHOIR BELOW`, `BONE ORCHARD`, `THE WARDEN'S DEBT`, `THE LAST ASCENT`.
- Mission structure uses `travel`, `interact`, `kill`, `choice`, and `extract` step types; campaign props are custom Three.js objects.
- Campaign progress persists in `localStorage` under `aethelgard.campaign.v1`; death retries current op, completion advances or records ending.
- Free Hunt remains available alongside Campaign; controller starts the campaign briefing by default.
- Final mission presents two physical consoles at Lift 04: upload the Choir (cyan) or burn it (orange), then a combat ascent and ending screen.

## Work State
### Completed
- Controller/gamepad support implemented, verified, documented, and committed as `305e2c8 Add gamepad support with controller HUD and menus`.
- Created `js/campaign.js` with:
  - Full five-mission story data, briefings, radio lines, fail/outro text, endings.
  - `CampaignProp` meshes for black box, relay, spires, Warden core, and choice consoles.
  - `CampaignRun` step runner, waypoint updates, authored enemy waves, Warden Prime boss, finale waves.
  - Campaign progress load/save helpers.
- Modified `js/enemies.js` to add `prime` drone variant with 1400 HP, larger scale, crown ring, stronger damage, distinct visuals.
- Added campaign UI markup in `index.html`:
  - Campaign + Free Hunt start buttons, campaign progress strip.
  - Mission panel, boss bar, radio comms overlay.
  - Campaign briefing screen and updated manual/story copy.
- Added `js/ui.js` support for:
  - Campaign progress and briefing population.
  - Mission checklist updates, dynamic waypoint marker, boss health bar.
  - Queued typewriter radio comms.
  - Campaign-aware end screen titles/actions.
- Started `js/game.js` integration: imported campaign helpers but no further edits applied yet.

### Active
- Integrating campaign lifecycle and UI into `js/game.js`.
- Adding `main.js` button/callback wiring for briefing, campaign deploy, and redeploy flow.
- Adding campaign-specific CSS and README documentation.
- Running syntax checks and browser verification of all five missions, endings, death retry, free hunt, and controller briefing flow.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish `js/game.js`: campaign mode state, `startCampaign`, `beginRun`, checkpoints, interaction props, objective/HUD updates, boss handling, end-screen campaign data, `redeploy`, `returnToMenu`, and gamepad briefing support.
2. Wire `js/main.js`: campaign button opens briefing, free-hunt button starts normal run, deploy/back handlers, expose briefing callbacks to `Game`, redeploy calls `game.redeploy()`.
3. Add campaign CSS for progress strip, mission panel, boss bar, comms, waypoint, briefing card, responsive layouts, and end-screen campaign styling.
4. Update `README.md` with campaign story, operations, persistence, and controls.
5. Syntax check all JS, run Chromium/Playwright verification, capture screenshots, and commit.

## Relevant Files
- `js/campaign.js`: campaign story data, props, step runner, boss/finale logic, progress persistence.
- `js/game.js`: central game loop; campaign integration still in progress.
- `js/main.js`: menu event handlers; needs campaign briefing/deploy/redeploy wiring.
- `js/ui.js`: campaign HUD/briefing/comms/end-screen methods.
- `index.html`: new campaign markup and briefing section.
- `styles.css`: needs campaign visual styles.
- `js/enemies.js`: prime boss variant.
- `js/player.js`: player mechanics, reset, movement.
- `js/world.js`: world layout and existing interactables.
- `js/gamepad.js`: controller input; briefing handling may need game.js hook.
- `README.md`: needs campaign documentation.
- `screenshots/`: verification captures, gitignored.
- `dist/`: generated deployment copy, gitignored; not edited directly.

## Important Context
- Current branch: `opencode/42241409075`; last commit `305e2c8`; campaign work is uncommitted.
- Existing local server was running at `http://localhost:3002/` via tmux session `aethelgard`; verify it still responds.
- Playwright CLI session previously named `aethel`, Chromium installed; use programmatic DOM/JS checks because model cannot inspect images.
- `UI` now imports `MISSIONS`/`CAMPAIGN_TITLE` from `campaign.js`; avoid introducing circular imports.
- `CampaignRun` expects these UI methods exactly: `setMission`, `updateMission`, `setWaypoint`, `clearWaypoint`, `setBoss`, `transmit`, `setCampaignProgress`.
- `CampaignRun` expects `Game` methods: `spawnDrone`, `startExtraction`, `campaignProgress`, `audio`, `effects`, `enemies`, `player.pos`, `time`.
- Campaign enemy kills are tagged via `drone.campaignTag`; boss via `drone.boss`.
- Mission 4 drops a `warden-core` prop at boss death location and activates it on the next step.
- Final mission choice calls `game.startExtraction()` immediately; finale waves spawn while extraction is active.
- Existing extraction credits scrap/cores/AETHER normally; campaign end screen should still show run stats.
- `startRun()` currently starts free hunt; must remain compatible with existing callers.
